Why does make-ready kickoff still create so much delay for property managers?

Because many teams treat the turnover handoff like a loose reminder instead of a controlled workflow. Property management automation should confirm the vacate event, package unit status, route the right scope, assign the first owner, trigger vendor or tech coordination, and write the current state back before the turn starts drifting.

This is where an AI front desk for property managers becomes operational leverage instead of just faster messaging. AI voice, SMS, resident communication, maintenance coordination, vendor routing, and property management CRM workflows should work as one system so make-ready starts with a clean brief instead of a scavenger hunt.

If your team still loses time to unclear vacate timing, missing inspection notes, duplicate vendor outreach, no visible owner, or turn work that starts late because context lived in inbox threads, the issue is not effort. The workflow is weak.
